title: Thomas Doubts and Believes
description: The disciple Thomas refuses to believe that Jesus has risen until he himself sees and touches the wounds. A week later, Jesus appears and Thomas confesses his faith.

versions.reason: [major] references: The story overlaps significantly with the existing 'Jesus appears to the disciples' entry covering John 20:19-31, including the Thomas episode. However, the Thomas story is a distinct, self-contained narrative that deserves its own entry; since the existing account already explicitly includes Thomas, they should either be merged or the focus clarified.
